# Setup Terraform

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Install Terraform or OpenTofu at a version resolved from the repo

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/setup-terraform@v1
```

## How it works

Terraform or OpenTofu setup with version resolution from the repo.

The binary is a parameter, not a hardcode, so the same pipelines serve Terraform and
OpenTofu repos. Version resolution order: explicit input → `.terraform-version` /
`.opentofu-version` → `latest`. tf-tools pins in `.terraform-version`, so the default
`auto` picks that up with no configuration.

`wrapper: false` by default. The HashiCorp wrapper captures stdout into step outputs,
which is handy for PR comments but silently truncates large plans and interferes with
exit codes; the plan action in this toolkit captures output itself.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `binary` | no | `terraform` | terraform \| tofu |
| `version` | no | `auto` | Version to install, or `auto` to read `.terraform-version`/`.opentofu-version`, or `latest`. |
| `wrapper` | no | `false` | true to install the stdout-capturing wrapper. Off by default. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory used to look for the version file. |
| `tflint` | no | `false` | true to also install tflint. |
| `tflint-version` | no | `latest` | tflint version. `latest` unless pinned. |
| `terraform-docs` | no | `false` | true to also install terraform-docs. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `binary` | The binary name to invoke (`terraform` or `tofu`). |
| `version` | The resolved version string. |
